content.name: Kha'ak Pressure
content.description: Sliders for how far the Kha'ak reach and how hard they push: the gate range a hive can place outposts within, the mining activity an outpost costs, and a multiplier on the chance mining spawns a Kha'ak group. Works on an existing savegame.
